title: Finance budget Q2 1:1 prep
content:
Purpose: quick sync with CFO ahead of exec budget review (next Tue). Goal: align on run-rate assumptions, highlight near-term procurement approvals, confirm runway sensitivity and hiring cadence for Q2.

High-level asks for the meeting:
- Confirm Q2 run-rate baseline and any adjustments to the growth hiring plan.
- Get decision on two procurement items needing approval this cycle (see below).
- Validate buffer policy: move from 6 weeks operating cash buffer to 8 weeks? show sensitivity.

Quick numbers (back-of-envelope, will bring workbook if asked):
- Current monthly opex burn (Feb actual): $1,520,000
  - Cloud/GPU infra: ~$550,000/mo (includes dedicated pools + burst)
  - COGS (third-party APIs, storage, embeddings): ~$120,000/mo
  - R&D salaries + benefits: ~$580,000/mo
  - Sales & Marketing: ~$180,000/mo
  - G&A: ~$90,000/mo
- Annualized run-rate (simple): $1.52M * 12 = $18.24M
- Cash runway (as of EOM Feb): 9.5 months at current burn (note: committed Dedicated contracts reduce downside but increase fixed cost)

Assumptions to call out:
- Hiring: paused two roles (backend infra eng x1, product manager x1) pending hiring committee sign-off; if unpaused, +$36k/mo run-rate incremental.
- Dedicated capacity commits: two purchases locked (May and July delivery) totaling $1.4M CapEx-equivalent (treated as committed Opex in runway calc for Q2 planning).
- Revenue growth: low-confidence uplift from new mid-market deals estimated +$200k/mo starting June (conservative scenario).

Procurement approvals (need explicit OK from CFO this week):
1) Nvidia A100 reserved capacity (contract amendment) — ask: approve $450k spend (one-time, prepay-option available). Rationale: locks pricing, reduces unit GPU cost by ~18% given current usage profile. Risk: prepay reduces cash; mitigation: take 6-month amortization in CapEx plan.
2) Datadog retention tier upgrade — ask: approve $24k/yr. Rationale: required for 90-day logs for Dedicated customers; sales requirement for two upcoming contracts.
3) Vendor consolidation (embedding provider) pilot extension — ask: $40k for 3-month pilot to validate cost/perf of alt provider. Low risk; if negative, stop.

Open questions I want Aisha (me) to raise / confirm with CFO:
- Buffer policy: recommended move to 8 weeks vs current 6 weeks; CFO view? impact: +$760k headroom requirement at current burn.
- Treatment of Dedicated contract prepayments: capitalization preference vs expense recognition (need guidance for Planning).
- Hiring prioritization if revenue underperforms: which two roles are top priority to keep recruiting for?

Sensitivity pick-up (to have on screen quickly):
- Burn +10% => runway falls to ~8.6 months
- Hiring +2 roles (full year) => +$0.43M annualized
- Accelerated infra prepay (take full $450k now) => cash down by $450k, runway -~0.3 months

Notes to self / talking points (choppy, so I can riff):
- Emphasize that infra prepay reduces unit cost; think in unit economics not just headline cash hit. Example: with prepay, token cost drop = net $0.003/token savings for heavy seq workloads; translates to ~20% lower infra COGS on inference-heavy customers.
- Link to sales ask: two mid-market deals are contingent on 90-day logs + Dedicated SLA; Datadog upgrade is low-cost to unlock ~ $120k ARR pipeline.
- Pilot: quick 3-month embedding pilot could shave ~12% off embedding line if it passes perf. Worth small spend to reduce recurring opex.

Draft agenda for 1:1 (15-20m):
1) Quick status (1-2m) — run-rate, runway headline.
2) Procurement asks (5-7m) — present 3 items, get direction.
3) Hiring & headcount tradeoffs (5m) — confirm freeze/priority.
4) Buffer / runway policy (2-3m) — CFO preference.
5) Actions & next steps (1-2m).

Action items (capture during/after meeting):
- [Aisha] Prepare one-page cost-benefit for Nvidia prepay option (include amortization scenarios) — due: Fri 2026-03-06.
- [Diego Martinez] Run updated 3-scenario runway model (base / worse / better) including dedicated prepay options — due: Thu 2026-03-05.
- [Lena Zhou] Confirm Datadog upgrade procurement path + procurement ticket creation (Procure-#) — due: Wed 2026-03-04 (ASAP).
- [Marcus Lee] Draft short email to sales ops re: 90-day log requirement for mid-market deals (copy CFO) — due: Thu 2026-03-05.
- [Aisha] Schedule follow-up with legal on contract amendment clauses for Nvidia reserve — due: Mon 2026-03-09.

Follow-ups post exec review (if approvals go through):
- Ops to update cash forecast and send updated runway to Exec (Aisha + Diego).
- Procurement to toggle prepay vs net-30 options in T&E system and capture in Q2 commit ledger.

Rough risks / mitigations (notes):
- Risk: Prepay reduces cash cushion. Mitigate: do partial prepay (50%) and negotiate staggered payments.
- Risk: Embedding pilot fails to deliver perf/cost -> sunk $40k. Mitigate: contract with clear exit clause and performance metrics.
- Risk: Hiring freeze causes product delays = revenue slippage. Mitigate: keep 1 senior infra hire on pipeline.

Scratchpad for numbers to add to final deck (fill after Diego runs model):
- Sensitivity table: burn +/-10/20% vs runway months.
- Breakout of infra unit costs pre/post prepay (per-token / per-1k tokens).
- P&L delta if Datadog upgrade unlocks expected $120k ARR (timing assumptions).

Unresolved items to chase before meeting:
- confirmation of exact committed Dedicated spend dates (procurement spreadsheet shows May + Jul, need PO numbers).
- final sales pipeline timing for those two mid-market deals (ask Marcus).

Notes to self: keep tone short, ask CFO for directional yes/no on prepay and Datadog. If CFO wants deeper analysis, offer Diego-run scenarios by EOD Thu.

END.
